methodology.scoreFormula: popularity + engineFit + upstreamActivity + liveHealth + coverage + penalty

weights.popularity: 0-30 prioritization proxy; explicit project seeds and broadly useful catalogs score higher. It is not a traffic measurement.
weights.engineFit: 0-25; 25 means an executable Ahoge shared runtime exists, 18 a high-leverage shared family is identified but not implemented, 12-15 a stable bespoke API looks viable, 0 Tier-4 custom challenge/descrambling.
weights.upstreamActivity: 0-20; current reviewed Keiyoushi module/revision scores highest, family-reviewed modules next, unverified seeds lower.
weights.liveHealth: 0-15; only current end-to-end Ahoge health validation receives 15. Untested, blocked, broken, or unsupported receive 0.
weights.coverage: 0-10; rewards language/catalog diversity and useful non-duplicate coverage.
weights.penalty: negative value for anti-bot/challenge, image descrambling, hard failures, or other maintenance risk.

methodology.healthGate: A candidate cannot be enabled unless its current Ahoge runtime passes live health validation, regardless of total score.

evidenceLevels.health-verified: Executed by Ahoge-compatible health checks in CI.
evidenceLevels.upstream-reviewed: Current upstream implementation inspected for runtime/maintenance characteristics.
evidenceLevels.family-reviewed: Current upstream module identified as a reusable multisrc family member; source-specific live behavior not yet tested.
evidenceLevels.seed-triage: Explicit project seed triaged for runtime fit; source-specific upstream/live validation remains.
evidenceLevels.triage: Broader candidate retained for later verification.
